_note: Owner: Role Building. One ability per class, cast when the mana bar is full. Owner: Role Building. Multipliers are of the caster's attack damage and are scaled by ability power (items). Timing of the cast lives in move_timing.json (Animations), not here. Top-level class-name keys are what the game reads today (mana, n = name, d = text). The keys the game reads today through src/data/load.js (Engineering) are kept exactly as they were. Everything else is Role Building's full structure; tests/role-building/data_check.mjs fails if the two ever disagree.

Warrior.d: Strikes the target and enemies beside it for 180% attack damage.

Healer.d: Heals the most hurt ally for 250% attack damage + 80.

Mage.d: Hurls a bolt for 320% attack damage as magic.

Judge Mark.d: Gains a shield worth 30% max HP for 4 s.

Ember Keeper.d: 150% attack damage as magic, then burns 3% max HP per second for 3 s.

Gusting Shallow.d: Knocks the target up, stunning it for 1.5 s, and deals 120% attack damage.

Quiet Concern.d: A guaranteed critical strike for 200% attack damage.

Leaf in the Wind.d: Steps behind the target, roots it for 1.5 s and strikes for 150%.
